records.abstract_cn: 为了分析气候变化缓解策略，经济学家依靠简化的气候模型（所谓的气候模拟器）以较低的计算成本提供二氧化碳排放与全球变暖之间的现实定量联系。在本文中，我们为这些气候模拟器提出了一种通用且透明的校准和评估策略，该策略基于可免费且轻松获取的来自气候科学的最先进基准数据。我们证明，自由模型参数的适当选择对于预测的碳社会成本至关重要。我们提出的关键想法是校准简化的气候模型，以参与耦合模型比对项目阶段5（CMIP5）的综合全球气候模型的基准数据。特别是，我们建议使用四在气候科学文献中被认为至关重要的不同测试用例：二高度理想化的测试来分别校准和评估碳循环和温度响应，理想化的测试来量化瞬态气候响应，以及最终的测试来评估与经济模型产生的场景相近的性能，其中包括外生强迫。作为一个具体的例子，我们重新校准了广泛使用的 DICE-2016 的气候部分，了解模型响应的 CMIP5 不确定性范围：多模型平均值以及极端但仍然允许的气候敏感性和碳循环响应。我们证明，DICE-2016 模型的气候模拟器的功能形式尽管简单，但符合目的，但其碳循环和温度方程校准错误，导致 一 可能对 DICE-2016 得出的预测持怀疑态度。我们研究了在利率为外生的部分均衡设置以及 DICE-2016 的简单一般均衡设置的背景下校准碳社会成本的重要性。我们发现，如果 一 假设二次损害函数，则气候系统不同一致校准的模型不确定性可以将碳的社会成本改变 4 倍。当校准到多模型均值时，我们的模型预测的碳社会成本值与原始 DICE-2016 相似，但对贴现率的敏感性大大降低，并且长期变暖程度降低约 1 度。 DICE-2016中碳的社会成本对贴现率过于敏感，导致对偏好变化的极端比较静态反应。

records.title_en: Good Politicians: Experimental Evidence on Motivations for Political Candidacy and Government Performance
records.title_cn: 优秀的政治家：政治候选人动机和政府绩效的实验证据
records.abstract_en: How can we motivate good politicians—those that will carry out policy that is responsive to citizens’ preferences—to enter politics? In a field experiment in Pakistan, we vary how political office is portrayed to ordinary citizens. Emphasizing prosocial motives for holding political office instead of personal returns—such as the ability to help others versus enhancing one’s own respect and status—raises the likelihood that individuals run for office and that voters elect them. A year later, the treatment improves the alignment of policy with citizens’ preferences. These effects emerge only when treatments are randomly delivered in a public setting. Taken together, the results demonstrate that how politics is perceived shapes who decides to run for office, who is elected, as well the policies that democracies deliver.
records.abstract_cn: 我们如何才能激励优秀的政治家——那些会执行响应公民偏好的政策的人——进入政坛？在巴基斯坦的一项实地实验中，我们改变了向普通公民描绘政治职位的方式。强调担任政治职务的亲社会动机而不是个人回报——例如帮助他人的能力与提高一自己的尊重和地位——增加了个人竞选公职和选民选举他们的可能性。一年后，这种待遇改善了政策与公民偏好的一致性。仅当在公共环境中随机进行治疗时，这些效果才会出现。总而言之，结果表明，人们对政治的看法影响着谁决定竞选公职、谁当选，以及民主国家实施的政策。

records.title_en: International Comovement in the Global Production Network
records.title_cn: 全球生产网络中的国际联动
records.abstract_en: This article provides a general framework to study the role of production networks in international GDP comovement. We first derive an additive decomposition of bilateral GDP comovement into components capturing shock transmission and shock correlation. We quantify this decomposition in a parsimonious multi-country, multi-sector dynamic network propagation model, using data for the G7 countries over the period 1978–2007. Our main finding is that while the network transmission of shocks is quantitatively important, it accounts for a minority of observed comovement under the estimated range of structural elasticities. Contemporaneous responses to correlated shocks in the production network are more successful at generating comovement than intertemporal propagation through capital accumulation. Extensions with multiple shocks, nominal rigidities, and international financial integration leave our main result unchanged. A combination of TFP and labour supply shocks is quantitatively successful at reproducing the observed international business cycle.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了研究生产网络在国际 GDP 联动中的作用的总体框架。我们第一将双边GDP联动分解为捕捉冲击传递和冲击相关性的组成部分。我们使用七国集团国家在1978-2007期间的数据，在一个简约的多国家、多部门动态网络传播模型中量化这种分解。我们的主要发现是，虽然冲击的网络传播在数量上很重要，但它占结构弹性估计范围内观察到的联动的一小部分。对生产网络中相关冲击的同期反应比通过资本积累进行的跨期传播更能成功地产生联动。多重冲击、名义刚性和国际金融一体化的扩展使我们的主要结果保持不变。全要素生产率和劳动力供应冲击的结合在数量上成功地再现了观察到的国际商业周期。

records.title_en: Transhumant Pastoralism, Climate Change, and Conflict in Africa
records.title_cn: 非洲的游牧放牧、气候变化和冲突
records.abstract_en: We consider the effects of climate change on seasonally migrant populations that herd livestock—i.e. transhumant pastoralists—in Africa. Traditionally, transhumant pastoralists benefit from a cooperative relationship with sedentary agriculturalists whereby arable land is used for crop farming in the wet season and animal grazing in the dry season. Rainfall scarcity can disrupt this arrangement by inducing pastoral groups to migrate to agricultural lands before the harvest, causing conflict to emerge. We examine this hypothesis by combining ethnographic information on the traditional locations of transhumant pastoralists and sedentary agriculturalists with high-resolution data on the location and timing of rainfall and violent conflict events in Africa from 1989 to 2018. We find that reduced rainfall in the territory of transhumant pastoralists leads to conflict in neighbouring areas. Consistent with the proposed mechanism, the conflicts are concentrated in agricultural areas; they occur during the wet season and not the dry season; and they are due to rainfall’s impact on plant biomass growth. Since pastoralists tend to be Muslim and agriculturalists Christian, this mechanism accounts for a sizable proportion of the rapid rise in religious conflict observed in recent decades. Regarding policy responses, we find that development aid projects tend not to mitigate the effects that we document. By contrast, the effects are reduced when transhumant pastoralists have greater power in national government, suggesting that more equal political representation is conducive to peace.
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑气候变化对放牧牲畜的季节性移民人口的影响，即放牧牲畜的人口。迁徙的牧民——在非洲。传统上，游牧牧民受益于与定居农民的合作关系，即耕地在雨季用于农作物种植，在旱季用于放牧动物。降雨稀缺可能会导致牧民在收获前迁移到农田，从而破坏这种安排，从而导致冲突的出现。我们通过将游牧牧民和定居农民的传统位置的人种学信息与1989至2018非洲降雨和暴力冲突事件的位置和时间的高分辨率数据相结合来检验这一假设。我们发现，游牧牧民境内降雨量减少导致邻近地区发生冲突。与拟议的机制一致，冲突集中在农业地区；它们发生在雨季而不是旱季；这是由于降雨对植物生物量生长的影响。由于牧民往往是穆斯林，而农耕者往往是基督徒，这种机制在近几十年来观察到的宗教冲突迅速上升中占了相当大的比例。关于政策反应，我们发现发展援助项目往往不会减轻我们记录的影响。相比之下，当游牧牧民在国家政府中拥有更大权力时，其影响就会减弱，这表明更平等的政治代表权有利于和平。

records.title_en: Reservation Raises: The Aggregate Labour Supply Curve at the Extensive Margin
records.title_cn: 保留率提高：广义边际的总劳动力供给曲线
records.abstract_en: We measure desired labour supply at the extensive (employment) margin in two representative surveys of the U.S. and German populations. We elicit reservation raises: the percent wage change that renders a given individual indifferent between employment and nonemployment. It is equal to her reservation wage divided by her actual, or potential, wage. The reservation raise distribution is the nonparametric aggregate labour supply curve. Locally, the curve exhibits large short-run elasticities above 3, consistent with business cycle evidence. For larger upward shifts, arc elasticities shrink towards 0.5, consistent with quasi-experimental evidence from tax holidays. Existing models fail to match this nonconstant, asymmetric curve.
records.abstract_cn: 我们在二对美国和德国人口的代表性调查中衡量了广泛（就业）边际的理想劳动力供给。我们引出保留加薪：使特定个人在就业和非就业之间变得无所谓的工资变化百分比。它等于她的保留工资除以她的实际或潜在工资。保留加薪分布是非参数总劳动力供给曲线。就局部而言，该曲线表现出高于3的较大短期弹性，这与经济周期证据一致。对于较大的向上偏移，弧弹性收缩至 0.5，与免税期的准实验证据一致。现有模型无法匹配这条非常量、不对称的曲线。

records.title_en: Robust Implementation with Costly Information
records.title_cn: 使用昂贵的信息进行稳健的实施
records.abstract_en: We construct mechanisms that can robustly implement any desired social choice function when (1) agents may incur a cost to learn the state of the world, (2) with small probability, agents’ preferences can be arbitrarily different from some baseline known to the mechanism designer, and (3) the mechanism designer does not know agents’ beliefs and higher-order beliefs about one another’s preferences. The mechanisms we propose have a natural interpretation and do not require the mechanism designer to be able to verify the state ex post. We also establish impossibility results for stronger notions of robust implementation.
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建的机制可以稳健地实现任何期望的社会选择函数，当（1）代理人可能会产生学习世界状态的成本，（2）小概率，代理人的偏好可以与机制设计者已知的某些基线任意不同，以及（3）机制设计者不知道代理人的信念和关于一另一个人的偏好的高阶信念。我们提出的机制有一个自然的解释，不需要机制设计者能够事后验证状态。我们还建立了不可能的结果，以增强强有力的实施理念。

records.title_en: The Causal Impact of Socio-Emotional Skills Training on Educational Success
records.title_cn: 社会情感技能培训对教育成功的因果影响
records.abstract_en: We study the long-term effects of a randomized intervention targeting children's socio-emotional skills. The classroom-based intervention for primary school children has positive impacts that persist for over a decade. Treated children become more likely to complete academic high school and enrol in university. Two mechanisms drive these results. Treated children show fewer attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder symptoms: they are less impulsive and less disruptive. They also attain higher grades, but they do not score higher on standardized tests. The long-term effects on educational attainment thus appear to be driven by changes in socio-emotional skills rather than cognitive skills.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究针对儿童社会情感技能的随机干预的长期影响。针对小学生的课堂干预产生了持续十多年的积极影响。接受治疗的儿童更有可能完成高中学业并进入大学。 二机制驱动这些结果。接受治疗的儿童表现出较少的注意力缺陷/多动障碍症状：他们较少冲动且较少破坏性。他们也取得了更高的成绩，但他们在标准化考试中得分并不高。因此，对教育程度的长期影响似乎是由社会情感技能的变化而不是认知技能的变化驱动的。

records.title_en: Surviving Competition: Neighbourhood Shops versus Convenience Chains
records.title_cn: 在竞争中生存：社区小店与连锁便利店
records.abstract_en: Hundreds of millions of microenterprises in emerging economies face increased competition from the entry and expansion of large firms that offer similar products. This paper examines the impacts of the opening of chain-run convenience stores on one of the world’s most ubiquitous microenterprises: owner-operated shops. To address endogeneity in time and location of chains’ opening, I pair two-way fixed effects with a novel instrument that shifts the profitability of chains but not of shops at the neighbourhood level. Expanding the number of chain outlets from zero to the neighbourhood average of 6.7 stores reduces the number of shops by 15%, a decline driven not by increased shop exits but by decreased shop entries. Shops retain their sales of fresh products and keep 96% of their customers, but customers visit shops less frequently and spend less on packaged goods. Surviving shops leverage competitive advantages stemming from being owner operated, such as lower agency costs, cultivating relationships with neighbours, and offering customers informal credit. The welfare gains of convenience chains replacing shops increase with household income; the poorest households experience a welfare loss.
records.abstract_cn: 数以亿计的新兴经济体微型企业，正面临提供相似产品的大型企业进入和扩张所带来的更激烈竞争。本文研究连锁便利店开业对世界上最常见的微型企业之一——个体经营小店——的影响。为解决连锁店开业时间和地点的内生性问题，作者将双向固定效应与一种新工具变量结合起来，该工具在社区层面上影响连锁店的盈利能力，但不影响小店的盈利能力。将连锁门店数量从零扩张到社区平均水平 6.7 家，会使小店数量减少15%，这一下降并非由小店退出增加所致，而是由小店新进入减少所致。小店仍保住了鲜活商品销售，并留住了96%的顾客，但顾客到店频率更低，在包装商品上的支出也更少。存活下来的小店利用了个体经营带来的竞争优势，例如更低的代理成本、与邻里的关系网络以及向顾客提供非正式赊账。连锁便利店替代小店带来的福利增益会随家庭收入上升而增加；最贫困家庭则会遭受福利损失。

records.title_en: Estimating Equilibrium in Health Insurance Exchanges: Price Competition and Subsidy Design under the ACA
records.title_cn: 估计健康保险交易所的均衡：ACA 下的价格竞争和补贴设计
records.abstract_en: Regulations to design private yet publicly sponsored health insurance markets are increasingly adopted in many OECD countries. Here I combine data and economic theory to analyse the interaction between insurers’ competition and the design of premium subsidies in determining equilibrium outcomes. My empirical model includes adverse selection, rich heterogeneity in preferences for vertically and horizontally differentiated plans and accommodates alternative assumptions on pricing conduct. In the context of the Affordable Care Act in the U.S., I estimate the joint distribution of preferences and expected cost using Californian administrative records on 3.4 million plan choices between 2014 and 2017, combined with plan and survey data on medical claims. An empirical horse race between conduct assumptions favours oligopoly pricing over perfect competition. Considering alternative subsidy designs shows that, in equilibrium, shifting subsidy generosity toward the “young invincibles” would lower premiums for all enrolees while increasing enrolment and profits.
records.abstract_cn: 许多经合组织国家越来越多地采用设计私人但公共资助的健康保险市场的法规。在这里，我结合数据和经济理论来分析保险公司竞争与保费补贴设计之间的相互作用，以确定均衡结果。我的实证模型包括逆向选择、对纵向和横向差异化计划的偏好的丰富异质性，并适应定价行为的替代假设。在美国《平价医疗法案》的背景下，我使用加州关于 3.4 和 2014 之间 2017 百万 计划选择的行政记录，结合医疗索赔的计划和调查数据，估计了偏好和预期成本的联合分布。行为假设之间的实证赛马有利于寡头垄断定价而不是完全竞争。考虑替代补贴设计表明，在均衡状态下，将补贴慷慨转向“年轻无敌”将降低所有参保者的保费，同时增加入学率和利润。

records.title_en: Long-Term Care Insurance and the Family
records.title_cn: 长期护理保险和家庭
records.abstract_en: This paper examines whether informal care by family members influences the demand for long-term care insurance. Motivated by evidence that the availability of informal caregivers correlates with lower insurance demand and that informal care substitutes for formal care, I estimate a dynamic model of long-term care decisions between an elderly parent and her adult child. The availability of informal care lowers demand for insurance by 7 percentage points and suppresses Medicaid spending. A policy that provides equivalent cash benefits for informal care for such families can generate meaningful increases in insurance demand and family welfare and decreases in Medicaid spending.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了家庭成员的非正式护理是否影响长期护理保险的需求。有证据表明，非正式护理人员的可用性与较低的保险需求相关，并且非正式护理取代了正式护理，我估计了老年父母与其成年子女之间长期护理决策的动态模型。非正式护理的可用性降低了保险需求 7 个百分点，并抑制了医疗补助支出。为此类家庭的非正式护理提供同等现金福利的政策可以显着增加保险需求和家庭福利，并减少医疗补助支出。

records.title_en: College Attrition and the Dynamics of Information Revelation
records.title_cn: 大学流失和信息披露的动态
records.abstract_en: We examine how informational frictions impact schooling and work outcomes by estimating a dynamic structural model where individuals face uncertainty about their academic ability and productivity, which determine their schooling utility and wages. We account for different college types, majors, occupational search frictions, and work hours. Individuals learn from grades and wages, which may affect their choices. Removing informational frictions would increase graduation by 4.4 percentage points and by an additional 2 points without search frictions. Providing students with full information about their abilities would increase the college and white-collar wage premia while reducing the graduation gap by family income.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过估计动态结构模型来研究信息摩擦如何影响学校教育和工作成果，在该模型中，个人面临着学术能力和生产力的不确定性，而学术能力和生产力决定了他们的教育效用和工资。我们考虑了不同的大学类型、专业、职业搜索摩擦和工作时间。个人从成绩和工资中学习，这可能会影响他们的选择。消除信息摩擦将使分级增加 4.4 个百分点，并且在没有搜索摩擦的情况下额外增加 2 个百分点。向学生提供有关其能力的完整信息将增加大学和白领的工资溢价，同时缩小家庭收入的毕业差距。

records.title_en: Bubble Necessity Theorem
records.title_cn: 泡沫必然性定理
records.abstract_en: Asset price bubbles are situations where asset prices exceed the fundamental values defined by the present value of dividends. This paper presents a conceptually new perspective: the necessity of bubbles. We establish the bubble necessity theorem in a plausible general class of economic models: with faster long-run economic growth (G) than dividend growth (Gd) and counterfactual long-run autarky interest rate (R) below dividend growth, all equilibria are bubbly with nonnegligible bubble sizes relative to the economy. This bubble necessity condition naturally arises in economies with sufficiently strong savings motives and multiple factors or sectors with uneven productivity growth.
records.abstract_cn: 资产价格泡沫是指资产价格超过股息现值定义的基本价值的情况。本文提出了一个概念上的新观点：泡沫的必要性。我们在一个看似合理的一般经济模型中建立了泡沫必要性定理：长期经济增长（G）快于股息增长（Gd），反事实的长期自给自足利率（R）低于股息增长，所有均衡都是有泡沫的，泡沫大小相对于经济而言不可忽视。这种泡沫必然性条件自然会出现在储蓄动机足够强、生产率增长不平衡的多种因素或部门的经济体中。

records.title_en: Endogenous Liquidity and Capital Reallocation
records.title_cn: 内生流动性和资本重新配置
records.abstract_en: This paper studies economies where firms acquire capital in primary markets and then, after idiosyncratic productivity shocks, retrade it in secondary markets that incorporate bilateral trade with search, bargaining, and liquidity frictions. We distinguish between full or partial sales (one firm gets all or some of the other’s capital) and document several long- and short-run empirical patterns between these variables and the cost of liquidity, as measured by inflation. Quantitatively, the model can match these patterns plus the standard business cycle facts. We also investigate the impact of search frictions, monetary and fiscal policy, persistence in shocks, and returns to scale.
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究的经济体中，企业在一级市场获取资本，然后在特殊的生产力冲击之后，在二级市场进行再交易，其中包括双边贸易、搜索、讨价还价和流动性摩擦。我们区分全部或部分销售（一公司获得对方的全部或部分资本），并记录这些变量与流动性成本（以通货膨胀衡量）之间的几种长期和短期经验模式。从数量上讲，该模型可以匹配这些模式以及标准经济周期事实。我们还研究了搜索摩擦、货币和财政政策、冲击的持续性以及规模回报的影响。

records.title_en: Disequilibrium Play in Tennis
records.title_cn: 网球运动中的不平衡打法
records.abstract_en: Do the world’s best tennis pros play Nash equilibrium mixed strategies? We answer this question using data on serve-direction choices (to the receiver’s left, right, or body) from the Match Charting Project. Using a new approach, we test and reject a key implication of a mixed-strategy Nash equilibrium: that the probability of winning the service game is identical for all possible serve strategies. We calculate best-response serve strategies by dynamic programming (DP) and show that for most elite pro servers, the DP strategy significantly increases their win probability relative to the mixed strategies they actually use.
records.abstract_cn: 世界上最好的网球职业选手会使用纳什均衡混合策略吗？我们使用比赛图表项目中有关发球方向选择（接球手的左侧、右侧或身体）的数据来回答这个问题。使用一种新方法，我们测试并拒绝混合策略纳什均衡的一个关键含义：赢得发球比赛的概率对于所有可能的发球策略都是相同的。我们通过动态规划（DP）计算最佳响应发球策略，并表明对于大多数精英职业发球手来说，相对于他们实际使用的混合策略，DP 策略显着提高了他们的获胜概率。

records.title_en: The Value of Information in Competitive Markets: Evidence from Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises
records.title_cn: 竞争市场中信息的价值：来自中小企业的证据
records.abstract_en: We empirically investigate how the performance of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) changes when gaining access to market information. To do so, we evaluate the impact of an information program diffused by a bank among its SME customers. Adopting firms gained access to reports with rich information about their own clientele and that of nearby establishments. While we find that adoption is associated with a 4.5% revenue increase, our instrumental variable results indicate that adoption increases revenue by 9%. The main mechanism driving our result is that the new information prompted adopting establishments to target gender-age customer groups underserved before adoption.
records.abstract_cn: 我们实证研究了中小企业（SME）在获取市场信息时绩效如何变化。为此，我们评估了银行在中小企业客户中传播的信息计划的影响。采用该技术的公司可以获得包含有关其自己的客户和附近机构的丰富信息的报告。虽然我们发现采用与 4.5% 收入增长相关，但我们的工具变量结果表明采用使收入增加 9%。推动我们结果的主要机制是，新信息促使收养机构针对收养前服务不足的性别年龄客户群体。

records.title_en: Mobility for All: Representative Intergenerational Mobility Estimates over the Twentieth Century
records.title_cn: 全民流动性：二十世纪代表性代际流动性估计
records.abstract_en: We estimate long-run trends in intergenerational relative mobility for representative samples of the US-born population. Harmonizing all surveys that include father’s occupation and own family income, we develop a mobility measure that allows for the inclusion of nonwhite individuals and women for the 1910s–1970s birth cohorts. We show that mobility increases between the 1910s and 1940s cohorts and that the decline of Black-white income gaps explains about half of this rise. We also find that excluding Black Americans, particularly women, considerably overstates the level of mobility for twentieth-century birth cohorts while simultaneously understating its increase between the 1910s and 1940s.
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了美国出生人口的代表性样本的代际相对流动性的长期趋势。通过协调包括父亲职业和自己家庭收入在内的所有调查，我们制定了一项流动性衡量标准，允许将非白人和女性纳入 1910–1970 出生群体中。我们发现 1910 和 1940 群体之间的流动性增加，而黑人与白人收入差距的缩小解释了这一增长的大约一半。我们还发现，排除美国黑人，特别是女性，大大高估了二十世纪出生群体的流动性水平，同时低估了1910和1940之间的流动性增长。

records.title_en: Occupational Choice, Matching, and Earnings Inequality
records.title_cn: 职业选择、匹配和收入不平等
records.abstract_en: We combine classic occupational choice (Roy model) and frictionless matching (following Sattinger) to explain earnings by occupation and firm in a way that is consistent with double assignment. In our model, within-firm inequality is globally nonzero whenever there is asymmetry in the revenue function or the occupational skill distribution across occupations. Occupational earnings overlap each other, and, unlike in the Roy model, the distributions of potential earnings are endogenous. In line with recent empirical findings on earning decomposition, skill-biased technical change increases within-firm inequality mostly among high-wage firms and not among low-wage firms.
records.abstract_cn: 我们结合经典的职业选择（罗伊模型）和无摩擦匹配（遵循 Sattinger），以与双重分配一致的方式解释职业和公司的收入。在我们的模型中，只要收入函数或跨职业的职业技能分布存在不对称性，企业内部的不平等就在全球范围内非零。职业收入相互重叠，并且与罗伊模型不同的是，潜在收入的分布是内生的。根据最近关于收入分解的实证研究结果，偏向技能的技术变革增加了公司内部的不平等，主要是在高工资公司而不是低工资公司。

records.title_en: Mussa Puzzle Redux
records.title_cn: 穆萨谜题终极版
records.abstract_en: The Mussa (1986) puzzle is the observation of a sharp and simultaneous increase in the volatility of both nominal and real exchange rates following the end of the Bretton Woods System of pegged exchange rates in 1973. It is commonly viewed as a central piece of evidence in favor of monetary non‐neutrality because it is an instance in which a change in the monetary regime caused a dramatic change in the equilibrium behavior of a real variable—the real exchange rate—and is often further interpreted as direct evidence in favor of models with nominal rigidities in price setting. This paper shows that the data do not support this latter conclusion because there was no simultaneous change in the properties of the other macro variables, nominal or real; an extended set of Mussa facts falsifies both conventional flexible‐price RBC models and sticky‐price New Keynesian models. We present a resolution to the broader Mussa puzzle based on a model of segmented financial market, in which the bulk of the nominal exchange rate risk is held by financial intermediaries and is not shared smoothly throughout the economy, emphasizing the importance of monetary transmission via the risk premium channel.
records.abstract_cn: Mussa（1986）之谜是在1973布雷顿森林体系结束钉住汇率之后观察到名义汇率和实际汇率的波动性同时急剧增加。它通常被视为支持货币非中性的核心证据，因为它是货币制度的变化导致实际变量（实际汇率）的均衡行为发生巨大变化的例子，并且通常被进一步解释为支持价格设定中名义刚性模型的直接证据。本文表明，数据并不支持后一个结论，因为其他宏观变量（名义变量或实际变量）的属性没有同时发生变化；一系列扩展的穆萨事实证伪了传统的灵活价格 RBC 模型和粘性价格新凯恩斯主义模型。我们基于分割金融市场的模型提出了更广泛的穆萨难题的解决方案，其中大部分名义汇率风险由金融中介机构持有，并且没有在整个经济中顺利分担，强调通过风险溢价渠道进行货币传导的重要性。

records.title_en: The Political Economy of Zero‐Sum Thinking
records.title_cn: 零-和思维的政治经济学
records.abstract_en: This paper offers a strategic rationale for zero‐sum thinking in elections. We show that asymmetric information and distributional considerations together make voters wary of policies supported by others. This force impels a majority of voters to support policies contrary to their preferences and information. Our analysis identifies and interprets a form of “adverse correlation” that is necessary and sufficient for zero‐sum thinking to prevail in equilibrium.
records.abstract_cn: 本文为选举中的零求和思维提供了战略依据。我们表明，信息不对称和分配考虑共同使选民对其他人支持的政策持谨慎态度。这种力量促使大多数选民支持与其偏好和信息相反的政策。我们的分析识别并解释了一种“逆相关”形式，这种形式对于零求和思维在均衡中盛行是必要且充分的。

records.title_en: Seeding a Simple Contagion
records.title_cn: 播下简单的传染病种子
records.abstract_en: I propose a method for selecting seeds to maximize contagion. First, fit a random graph model using a coarse categorization of individuals. Next, compute a seed multiplier for each category—this is the average number of new infections a seed generates. Finally, seed the category with the highest multiplier. Relative to the most common methods, my approach requires far less granular data, and it consumes less computing power—the problem scales with the number of categories, not the number of individuals. I validate the methodology through simulations using real network data.
records.abstract_cn: 我提出了一种选择种子以最大化传染的方法。 第一，使用个体的粗分类来拟合随机图模型。接下来，计算每个类别的种子乘数 - 这是种子产生的新感染的平均数量。最后，为乘数最高的类别播种。相对于最常见的方法，我的方法需要的数据粒度要少得多，并且消耗的计算能力也更少——问题随着类别的数量而不是个体的数量而变化。我通过使用真实网络数据进行模拟来验证该方法。

records.title_en: History's Masters The Effect of European Monarchs on State Performance
records.title_cn: 历史大师欧洲君主对国家表现的影响
records.abstract_en: We create a novel reign‐level data set for European monarchs, covering all major European states between the 10th and 18th centuries. We first document a strong positive relationship between rulers' cognitive ability and state performance. To address endogeneity issues, we exploit the facts that (i) rulers were appointed according to hereditary succession, independent of their ability, and (ii) the widespread inbreeding among the ruling dynasties of Europe led over centuries to quasirandom variation in ruler ability. We code the degree of blood relationship between the parents of rulers, which also reflects “hidden” layers of inbreeding from previous generations. The coefficient of inbreeding is a strong predictor of ruler ability, and the corresponding instrumental variable results imply that ruler ability had a sizeable effect on the performance of states and their borders. This supports the view that “leaders made history,” shaping the European map until its consolidation into nation states. We also show that rulers mattered only where their power was largely unconstrained. In reigns where parliaments checked the power of monarchs, ruler ability no longer affected their state's performance.
records.abstract_cn: 我们为欧洲君主创建了一个新颖的统治级别数据集，涵盖 10 和 18 世纪之间的所有主要欧洲国家。我们第一记录了统治者的认知能力和国家绩效之间存在很强的正相关关系。为了解决内生性问题，我们利用以下事实：（i）统治者是根据世袭继承任命的，与他们的能力无关；（ii）欧洲统治王朝之间广泛的近亲繁殖导致几个世纪以来统治者能力的准随机变化。我们对统治者父母之间的血缘关系程度进行编码，这也反映了前几代人“隐藏”的近亲繁殖层。近亲繁殖系数是统治者能力的有力预测因子，相应的工具变量结果表明统治者能力对国家及其边界的表现有相当大的影响。这支持了“领导人创造历史”的观点，塑造了欧洲版图，直至其合并为民族国家。我们还表明，统治者只有在权力基本上不受限制的情况下才重要。在议会制衡君主权力的统治时期，统治者的能力不再影响国家的表现。

records.title_en: The Margins of Trade
records.title_cn: 贸易利润
records.abstract_en: Welfare depends on the quantity, quality, and range of goods consumed. We use trade data, which report the quantities and prices of the individual goods that countries exchange, to learn about how the gains from trade and growth break down into these different margins. Our general equilibrium model, in which both quality and quantity contribute to consumption and to production, captures (i) how prices increase with importer and exporter per capita income, (ii) how the range of goods traded rises with importer and exporter size, and (iii) how products traveling longer distances have higher prices. Our framework can deliver a standard gravity formulation for total trade flows and for the gains from trade. We find that growth in the extensive margin contributes to about half of overall gains. Quality plays a larger role in the welfare gains from international trade than from economic growth due to selection.
records.abstract_cn: 福利取决于消费商品的数量、质量和范围。我们使用贸易数据（报告各国交换的个别商品的数量和价格）来了解贸易和增长的收益如何分解为这些不同的利润。我们的一般均衡模型，其中质量和数量都对消费和生产作出贡献，捕捉了（i）价格如何随着进口商和出口商人均收入的增加而增加，（ii）贸易商品的范围如何随着进口商和出口商规模的增加而增加，以及（iii）运输距离较长的产品如何具有较高的价格。我们的框架可以为总贸易流量和贸易收益提供标准的重力公式。我们发现，粗放利润的增长约占整体收益的一半。与选择带来的经济增长相比，质量在国际贸易带来的福利收益中发挥的作用更大。

records.title_en: How Well Does Bargaining Work in Consumer Markets? A Robust Bounds Approach
records.title_cn: 消费市场中的讨价还价效果如何？稳健界限方法
records.abstract_en: This study provides a structural analysis of detailed, alternating‐offer bargaining data from eBay, deriving bounds on buyers and sellers private value distributions and the gains from trade using a range of assumptions on behavior and the informational environment. These assumptions range from weak (assuming only that acceptance and rejection decisions are rational) to less weak (e.g., assuming that bargaining offers are weakly increasing in players' private values). We estimate the bounds and show what they imply for consumer negotiation behavior and inefficient breakdown. For the median product, bargaining ends in impasse in 37% of negotiations even when the buyer values the good more than the seller.
records.abstract_cn: 本研究对来自 eBay 的详细的交替报价讨价还价数据进行了结构分析，利用一系列行为和信息环境假设推导了买家和卖家的私人价值分布和贸易收益的界限。这些假设的范围从弱（仅假设接受和拒绝决策是理性的）到较弱（例如，假设讨价还价在参与者的私人价值中微弱增加）。我们估计界限并显示它们对消费者谈判行为和低效故障的影响。对于中间产品，即使买方比卖方更看重商品，讨价还价也会在37%谈判中陷入僵局。

records.title_en: Persuasion Meets Delegation
records.title_cn: 说服与授权的结合
records.abstract_en: A principal can restrict an agent's information (the persuasion problem) or discretion (the delegation problem). We study these two problems under standard single‐crossing assumptions on the agent's marginal utility. We show that these problems are equivalent on the set of monotone stochastic mechanisms, implying, in particular, the equivalence of deterministic delegation and monotone partitional persuasion. We also show that the monotonicity restriction is superfluous for linear persuasion and linear delegation, implying their equivalence on the set of all stochastic mechanisms. Finally, using tools from the persuasion literature, we characterize optimal delegation mechanisms, thereby generalizing and extending existing results in the delegation literature.
records.abstract_cn: 委托人可以限制代理人的信息（说服问题）或自由裁量权（授权问题）。我们在代理人边际效用的标准单交叉假设下研究这些二问题。我们证明这些问题在单调随机机制集上是等价的，特别意味着确定性委托和单调分区说服的等价性。我们还表明，单调性限制对于线性说服和线性委托来说是多余的，这意味着它们在所有随机机制的集合上是等价的。最后，使用说服文献中的工具，我们描述了最佳授权机制，从而概括和扩展了授权文献中的现有结果。

records.title_en: Tell Me Something I Don't Already Know: Learning in Low‐ and High‐Inflation Settings
records.title_cn: 告诉我一些我还不知道的事情：在低通胀和高通胀环境下学习
records.abstract_en: Using randomized control trials (RCTs) applied over time in different countries, we study whether the economic environment affects how agents learn from new information. We show that as inflation rose in advanced economies, both households and firms became more attentive and informed about publicly available news about inflation, leading them to respond less to exogenously provided information about inflation and monetary policy. We also study the effects of RCTs in countries where inflation has been consistently high (Uruguay) and low (New Zealand) as well as what happens when the same agents are repeatedly provided information in both low‐ and high‐inflation environments (Italy). Our results broadly support models in which inattention is an endogenous outcome that depends on the economic environment.
records.abstract_cn: 通过在不同国家长期应用的随机对照试验（RCT），我们研究经济环境是否影响主体从新信息中学习的方式。我们发现，随着发达经济体通胀上升，家庭和企业都变得更加关注并了解有关通胀的公开新闻，导致他们对外部提供的有关通胀和货币政策的信息反应较少。我们还研究了随机对照试验在通胀持续高位（乌拉圭）和低位（新西兰）的国家中的影响，以及在低通胀和高通胀环境（意大利）中重复提供相同信息时会发生什么。我们的结果广泛支持以下模型：注意力不集中是取决于经济环境的内生结果。

records.title_en: Minimum Wages, Efficiency, and Welfare
records.title_cn: 最低工资、效率和福利
records.abstract_en: Many argue that minimum wages can prevent efficiency losses from monopsony power. We assess this argument in a general equilibrium model of oligopsonistic labor markets with heterogeneous workers and firms. We decompose welfare gains into an efficiency component that captures reductions in monopsony power and a redistributive component that captures the way minimum wages shift resources across people. The minimum wage that maximizes the efficiency component of welfare lies below $8.00 and yields gains worth less than 0.2% of lifetime consumption. When we add back in Utilitarian redistributive motives, the optimal minimum wage is $11 and redistribution accounts for 102.5% of the resulting welfare gains, implying offsetting efficiency losses of −2.5%. The reason a minimum wage struggles to deliver efficiency gains is that with realistic firm productivity dispersion, a minimum wage that eliminates monopsony power at one firm causes severe rationing at another. These results hold under an EITC and progressive labor income taxes calibrated to the U.S. economy.
records.abstract_cn: 许多人认为，最低工资可以防止垄断势力带来的效率损失。我们在具有异质工人和企业的寡头垄断劳动力市场的一般均衡模型中评估了这一论点。我们将福利收益分解为效率部分（反映垄断权力的减少）和再分配部分（反映最低工资在人们之间转移资源的方式）。最大化福利效率部分的最低工资低于8.00美元，并且产生的收益低于终生消费的0.2%。当我们加上功利主义再分配动机时，最优最低工资为11美元，再分配占由此产生的福利收益的102.5%，这意味着抵消2.5%的效率损失。最低工资难以带来效率提升的原因是，在现实的企业生产率分散的情况下，消除一公司垄断权力的最低工资会导致另一家公司严重配给。这些结果在 EITC 和根据美国经济调整的累进劳动所得税下成立。

records.title_en: Five Facts about MPCs: Evidence from a Randomized Experiment
records.title_cn: 五 关于 MPC 的事实：来自随机实验的证据
records.abstract_en: We present five facts from an experiment on the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) out of transitory transfers: (1) the one-month MPC on a cash-like transfer is 23 percent; (2) it is substantially higher (61 percent) on a transfer administered via a card where remaining funds expire after three weeks, inconsistent with money fungibility; (3) the consumption response is concentrated in the first three weeks; (4) MPCs vary with household characteristics but are high even for the liquid wealthy; (5) unconditional MPC distribution exhibits large variation. Our findings inform the design of stimulus policies and pose challenges to existing macroeconomic models.
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过一项有关临时转移的边际消费倾向 (MPC) 的实验来呈现 五 事实： (1) 类似现金转移的 一 月 MPC 为 23%； (2) 通过卡管理的转账要高得多 (61%)，其中剩余资金在 三 周后到期，这与货币可互换性不一致； (3) 消费反应集中在 第一 三 周内； (4) MPC 因家庭特征而异，但即使对于流动性富裕的人来说，MPC 也很高； (5) 无条件 MPC 分布表现出很大的变化。我们的研究结果为刺激政策的设计提供了信息，并对现有的宏观经济模型提出了挑战。

records.title_en: Universalism: Global Evidence
records.title_cn: 普遍主义：全球证据
records.abstract_en: This paper leverages nationally representative surveys across 60 countries and 64,000 respondents to present novel stylized facts about the relationship-specific nature of altruism. Across individuals, universalist preferences systematically vary with demographics such as age and religiosity and are predictive of many left-wing political views, albeit in culturally highly heterogeneous ways. Across countries, universalism is strongly linked to a broader radius of trust. Looking at origins, universalism varies with the economic, political, and religious organization of societies in ways that are consistent with the idea that the scope of altruism is partly shaped by economic incentives and democracy.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用对 60 国家和 64,000 受访者进行的全国代表性调查，提出有关利他主义的关系特定性质的新颖的程式化事实。对于个人而言，普世主义偏好会随着年龄和宗教信仰等人口统计数据的不同而系统性地变化，并且预示着许多左翼政治观点，尽管在文化上存在高度异质性。在各个国家，普遍主义与更广泛的信任半径密切相关。从起源来看，普世主义随着社会的经济、政治和宗教组织而变化，其方式与利他主义的范围部分由经济激励和民主决定的理念是一致的。

records.title_en: In Harm's Way? Infrastructure Investments and the Persistence of Coastal Cities
records.title_cn: 处于危险之中？基础设施投资与沿海城市的持续存在
records.abstract_en: Coasts contain a disproportionate share of the world's population, reflecting historical advantages, but environmental change threatens a reversal of coastal fortune in the coming decades as natural disasters intensify and sea levels rise. This paper considers whether large infrastructure investments should continue to favor coastal areas. I estimate a dynamic spatial equilibrium framework using detailed geo-referenced data on road investments in Vietnam from 2000 to 2010 and find evidence that coastal favoritism has significant costs. The results highlight the importance of accounting for the dynamic effects of environmental change in deciding where to allocate infrastructure today.
records.abstract_cn: 沿海地区人口占世界人口的比例过高，这反映了历史优势，但随着自然灾害加剧和海平面上升，未来几十年环境变化可能会逆转沿海地区的命运。本文探讨大型基础设施投资是否应继续向沿海地区倾斜。我使用越南道路投资的详细地理参考数据（从 2000 到 2010）估计了动态空间平衡框架，并找到了沿海偏袒造成巨大成本的证据。结果强调了在决定当今基础设施分配地点时考虑环境变化的动态影响的重要性。

records.title_en: Price Floors and Employer Preferences: Evidence from a Minimum Wage Experiment
records.title_cn: 价格下限和雇主偏好：来自最低工资实验的证据
records.abstract_en: Firms posting job openings in an online labor market were randomly assigned minimum hourly wages. When facing a minimum wage, fewer firms hired, but those they did hire paid higher wages. Hours-worked fell substantially. Treated firms shifted to hiring more productive workers. Using the platform's imposition of a market-wide minimum wage after the experiment, I find that many of the experimental results also hold in equilibrium, including the substitution towards more productive workers. However, there was also a large reduction in the number of jobs posted for which the minimum wage would likely bind.
records.abstract_cn: 在在线劳动力市场上发布职位空缺的公司被随机分配最低小时工资。当面临最低工资时，雇用的公司减少，但雇用的公司却支付更高的工资。工作时间大幅下降。接受治疗的公司转向雇用更有生产力的工人。通过实验后平台对整个市场施加的最低工资，我发现许多实验结果也保持均衡，包括对生产力更高的工人的替代。然而，受最低工资约束的职位数量也大幅减少。

records.title_en: Heterogeneity in School Value Added and the Private Premium
records.title_cn: 学校增值和私人保费的异质性
records.abstract_en: We estimate and validate test score–based measures of school quality (school value added, or SVA) in Pakistan. We document substantial variation in SVA within villages and within the public and private sectors, leading to a wide range of possible estimates of the private premium. We also show that parents value SVA. Heterogeneity in parental demand for quality helps explain both the evolution of the market over time and cross-market variation in school quality. The supply side responds to parental demand for quality in the private sector, but there is no evidence it does so in the public sector.
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估并验证了巴基斯坦基于考试成绩的学校质量衡量标准（学校附加值，或 SVA）。我们记录了村庄内部以及公共和私营部门内部 SVA 的巨大差异，从而导致对私人保费的可能估计范围很广。我们还表明家长重视 SVA。家长对质量需求的异质性有助于解释市场随时间的演变以及学校质量的跨市场变化。私营部门的供应方响应了家长对质量的需求，但没有证据表明公共部门也这样做。

records.title_en: Organized Voters: Elections and Public Funding of Nonprofits
records.title_cn: 有组织的选民：选举和非营利组织的公共资助
records.abstract_en: What makes politicians respond to civil society organizations' demands? I use new data on government transfers to French associations and exploit close elections to show that politicians grant more funds to ideologically close organizations when the local incumbent is a political ally and was elected by a small margin. The results are consistent with politicians and organizations exchanging financial support for electoral support. Organizations secure funding because of the votes they can deliver, not because of their campaign contributions; however, the fact that transfers appear to be conditioned on support may undermine their ability to help hold politicians accountable.
records.abstract_cn: 是什么让政治家对民间社会组织的要求做出回应？我使用有关政府向法国协会转移的新数据，并利用势均力敌的选举来表明，当当地现任者是政治盟友并以微弱优势当选时，政治家会向意识形态上接近的组织提供更多资金。结果与政治家和组织用财政支持换取选举支持的结果是一致的。组织获得资金是因为它们可以提供选票，而不是因为它们的竞选捐款；然而，转移似乎以支持为条件的事实可能会削弱他们帮助追究政客责任的能力。

records.title_en: The Global Financial Resource Curse
records.title_cn: 全球金融资源诅咒
records.abstract_en: We provide a model connecting the global saving glut to productivity growth. The key feature is that the tradable sector is the engine of growth of the economy. Capital flows from developing countries to the United States boost demand for US nontradable goods, inducing a reallocation of US economic activity from the tradable sector to the nontradable one. In turn, lower profits in the tradable sector lead firms to cut back investment in innovation. Since innovation in the United States determines the evolution of the world technological frontier, the result is a drop in global productivity growth.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个将全球储蓄过剩与生产率增长联系起来的模型。关键特征是可贸易部门是经济增长的引擎。从发展中国家流向美国的资本增加了对美国非贸易商品的需求，导致美国经济活动从可贸易部门重新分配到非贸易部门。反过来，贸易部门的利润下降导致企业削减创新投资。由于美国的创新决定了世界技术前沿的演变，其结果就是全球生产率增速下降。

records.title_en: Dying or Lying? For-Profit Hospices and End-of-Life Care
records.title_cn: 死亡还是撒谎？营利性临终关怀和临终关怀
records.abstract_en: The Medicare hospice program is intended to provide palliative care to terminal patients, but patients with long stays in hospice are highly profitable, motivating concerns about overuse among the Alzheimer's and Dementia (ADRD) population in the rapidly growing for-profit sector. We provide the first causal estimates of the effect of for-profit hospice on patient spending using the entry of for-profit hospices over 20 years. We find hospice has saved money for Medicare by offsetting other expensive care among ADRD patients. As a result, policies limiting hospice use including revenue caps and antifraud lawsuits are distortionary and deter potentially cost-saving admissions.
records.abstract_cn: 医疗保险临终关怀计划旨在为临终患者提供姑息治疗，但长期住院临终关怀的患者利润丰厚，这引发了人们对快速增长的营利性部门中阿尔茨海默氏症和痴呆症 (ADRD) 人群过度使用的担忧。我们使用 20 年间营利性临终关怀医院的条目，提供营利性临终关怀中心对患者支出影响的 第一 因果估计。我们发现临终关怀通过抵消 ADRD 患者的其他昂贵护理费用，为医疗保险节省了资金。因此，限制临终关怀服务的政策，包括收入上限和反欺诈诉讼，都是扭曲的，阻碍了潜在的节省成本的入院治疗。

records.title_en: Whatever It Takes? The Impact of Conditional Policy Promises
records.title_cn: 无论如何？有条件政策承诺的影响
records.abstract_en: At the announcement of a new policy, agents form a view of state-contingent policy actions and impact. We develop a method to estimate this state-contingent perception and implement it for many asset-purchase interventions worldwide. Expectations of larger support in bad states—"policy puts"—explain a large fraction of the announcements' impact. For example, when the Fed introduced purchases of corporate bonds in March 2020, markets expected five times more price support had conditions worsened relative to the median scenario. Perceived promises of additional support in bad states alter asset prices, risk, and the response to future announcements.
records.abstract_cn: 在宣布新政策时，代理人会对国家可能采取的政策行动和影响形成看法。我们开发了一种方法来估计这种与状态相关的认知，并将其应用于全球许多资产购买干预措施。对糟糕国家提供更大支持的预期——“政策看跌”——解释了公告影响的很大一部分。例如，当美联储以 三月 2020 的价格购买公司债券时，市场预期 五 倍的价格支持会导致情况相对于中值情况恶化。在糟糕的状态下提供额外支持的承诺会改变资产价格、风险以及对未来公告的反应。

records.title_en: Dynamic Inconsistency in Risky Choice: Evidence from the Lab and Field
records.title_cn: 风险选择中的动态不一致：来自实验室和现场的证据
records.abstract_en: We document a robust dynamic inconsistency in risky choice. Using a unique brokerage dataset and a series of experiments, we compare people's initial risk-taking plans to their subsequent decisions. Across settings, people accept risk as part of a loss-exit strategy—planning to continue taking risk after gains and stopping after losses. Actual behavior deviates from initial strategies by cutting gains early and chasing losses. More people accept risk when offered a commitment to their initial strategy. Our results help reconcile seemingly contradictory findings on risk-taking in static versus dynamic contexts. We explore implications for theory and welfare.
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了风险选择中的强大动态不一致。使用独特的经纪数据集和一系列实验，我们将人们最初的冒险计划与随后的决策进行比较。在各种情况下，人们都接受风险作为损失退出策略的一部分——计划在收益后继续承担风险，在损失后停止。实际行为会偏离最初的策略，提前削减收益并追逐损失。更多的人在承诺执行最初的策略时会接受风险。我们的结果有助于调和静态与动态环境中看似矛盾的冒险发现。我们探索对理论和福利的影响。

records.title_en: Digital Distractions with Peer Influence: The Impact of Mobile App Usage on Academic and Labor Market Outcomes
records.title_cn: 具有同伴影响的数字干扰：移动应用程序使用对学术和劳动力市场结果的影响
records.abstract_en: Concerns about excessive mobile phone use among youth are mounting. We present estimates of behavioral and contextual peer effects, along with comprehensive evidence on how students’ own and their peers’ app usage affect academic performance, physical health, and labor market outcomes. Our analysis draws on administrative data from a Chinese university covering three student cohorts over four years. We exploit random roommate assignments, differential exposure to a policy shock (gaming restrictions for minors), and differential exposure to a discrete event (the introduction of a blockbuster video game) for identification. App usage is contagious: a one s.d. increase in roommates’ in-college app usage raises own usage by 5.8%. High app usage is harmful across all measured outcomes. A one s.d. increase in app usage reduces GPAs by 36.2% of a within-cohort-major s.d. and lowers wages by 2.3%. Roommates’ app usage reduces a student’s GPA and wages through both disruptions and behavioral spillovers, generating a total negative effect that exceeds half the magnitude of the impact from the student’s own app usage. Extending China’s three-hour-per-week gaming restriction for minors to college students would boost their initial wages by 0.9%. High-frequency GPS and app usage data show that heavy app users spend less time in study halls, are more frequently late or absent from class, and get less sleep.
records.abstract_cn: 对年轻人过度使用手机的担忧日益加剧。我们提供了对行为和同伴影响的估计，以及关于学生自己和同伴的应用程序使用如何影响学业成绩、身体健康和劳动力市场结果的综合证据。我们的分析借鉴了中国大学的行政数据，涵盖三年四年的学生群体。我们利用随机的室友分配、政策冲击的差异暴露（未成年人的游戏限制）以及离散事件的差异暴露（热门视频游戏的推出）来进行识别。应用程序的使用具有传染性：a 一 s.d.室友在大学内应用程序使用量的增加使自己的使用量增加了 5.8%。高应用程序使用率对所有测量结果都是有害的。 A 一 s.d.应用程序使用量的增加会使同组内专业 s.d 的 GPA 降低 36.2%。并将工资降低2.3%。室友的应用程序使用会通过干扰和行为溢出降低学生的 GPA 和工资，产生的总体负面影响超过学生自己的应用程序使用影响程度的一半。将中国对未成年人每周玩游戏的三小时限制扩大到大学生将使他们的初始工资增加0.9%。高频 GPS 和应用程序使用数据显示，大量使用应用程序的用户在自习室花费的时间更少，迟到或缺课的频率更高，睡眠时间也更少。

records.title_en: Diversifying Society’s Leaders? The Determinants and Causal Effects of Admission to Highly Selective Private Colleges
records.title_cn: 社会领袖多元化？进入高选择性私立大学的决定因素和因果效应
records.abstract_en: We use anonymized admissions data from several colleges linked to income tax records and SAT and ACT test scores to study the determinants and causal effects of attending Ivy-Plus colleges (Ivy League, Stanford, MIT, Duke, and Chicago). Children from families in the top 1% are more than twice as likely to attend an Ivy-Plus college as those from middle-class families with comparable SAT/ACT scores. Two-thirds of this gap is due to higher admission rates for students with comparable test scores from high-income families; the remaining third is due to differences in rates of application and matriculation. In contrast, children from high-income families have no admissions advantage at flagship public colleges. The high-income admissions advantage at Ivy-Plus colleges is driven by three factors: (i) preferences for children of alumni, (ii) weight placed on nonacademic credentials, and (iii) athletic recruitment. Using a new research design that isolates idiosyncratic variation in admissions decisions for waitlisted applicants, we show that attending an Ivy-Plus college instead of the average flagship public college increases students’ chances of reaching the top 1% of the earnings distribution by 50%, nearly doubles their chances of attending an elite graduate school, and almost triples their chances of working at a prestigious firm. The three factors that give children from high-income families an admissions advantage are uncorrelated or negatively correlated with postcollege outcomes, whereas academic credentials such as SAT/ACT scores are highly predictive of postcollege success.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用来自几所大学的匿名录取数据，这些数据与所得税记录以及 SAT 和 ACT 考试成绩相关，来研究就读常春藤+大学（常春藤盟校、斯坦福大学、麻省理工学院、杜克大学和芝加哥大学）的决定因素和因果效应。与 SAT/ACT 成绩相当的中产阶级家庭的孩子相比，来自顶尖 1% 家庭的孩子进入常春藤大学的可能性是后者的两倍多。 二-这一差距的三分之一是由于来自高收入家庭的具有可比考试成绩的学生的录取率较高；剩下的第三是由于申请率和入学率的差异造成的。相比之下，高收入家庭的孩子在旗舰公立大学没有入学优势。常春藤+大学的高收入录取优势是由三因素驱动的：（i）对校友子女的偏好，（ii）对非学术证书的重视，以及（iii）体育招生。我们使用一种新的研究设计，隔离了候补申请者录取决策中的特殊差异，结果表明，就读常春藤+大学而不是普通的旗舰公立大学，学生达到收入分配顶端1%的机会增加了50%，进入精英研究生院的机会几乎增加了一倍，在著名公司工作的机会几乎增加了三倍。为高收入家庭的孩子提供入学优势的因素与大学毕业后的成绩不相关或负相关，而 SAT/ACT 成绩等学术证书可以高度预测大学毕业后的成功。

records.title_en: Failing Banks
records.title_cn: 倒闭的银行
records.abstract_en: Why do banks fail? We create a panel covering most commercial banks from 1863 through 2024 to study the history of failing banks in the United States. Failing banks are characterized by rising asset losses, deteriorating solvency, and an increasing reliance on expensive noncore funding. These commonalities imply that bank failures are highly predictable using simple accounting metrics from publicly available financial statements. Failures with runs were common before deposit insurance, but these failures are strongly related to weak fundamentals, casting doubt on the importance of non-fundamental runs. Furthermore, low recovery rates on failed banks’ assets suggest that most failed banks subject to runs were fundamentally insolvent, barring large value destruction of receiverships. Altogether, our evidence suggests that the primary cause of bank failures and banking crises is almost always and everywhere a deterioration of bank fundamentals.
records.abstract_cn: 银行为何倒闭？我们创建了一个涵盖从1863到2024的大多数商业银行的小组来研究美国银行倒闭的历史。破产银行的特点是资产损失增加、偿付能力恶化以及对昂贵的非核心资金的依赖日益增加。这些共性意味着，使用公开财务报表中的简单会计指标，银行倒闭是高度可预测的。在存款保险出现之前，挤兑失败很常见，但这些失败与基本面疲软密切相关，这让人们对非基本面挤兑的重要性产生了怀疑。此外，破产银行资产的回收率较低，这表明大多数遭受挤兑的破产银行基本上已经资不抵债，除非破产管理权遭受重大价值损失。总而言之，我们的证据表明，银行倒闭和银行危机的主要原因几乎在任何地方都是银行基本面的恶化。

records.title_en: Traditional Institutions in Modern Times: Dowries as Pensions When Sons Migrate
records.title_cn: 现代社会中的传统制度：儿子迁移时，嫁妆如何充当养老金
records.abstract_en: This paper uses newly collected data on the allocation of dowry to examine its role in resolving intergenerational frictions around migration in India. Migration disrupts traditional elderly support structures, in which sons live near their parents and care for them in old age. We develop a model in which dowry can promote migration by allowing sons to make upfront transfers to their parents and ease constraints on income sharing. To test this hypothesis, we collect two new data sets that measure the distribution of dowry between family members. We document for the first time that net transfers of dowry to a man’s parents are common but far from universal. Consistent with using dowry for income sharing, such transfers occur more often when sons migrate, especially when they work in higher-earning occupations. In nationally representative data, migration rates are higher in areas with stronger historical dowry traditions. Finally, exploiting a large-scale highway construction program, we show that men from areas with stronger historical dowry traditions migrate more when migration costs fall. Our findings provide some clues as to why dowry persists despite its well-documented adverse consequences.
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用新收集的嫁妆分配数据，考察嫁妆在缓解印度家庭因迁移产生的代际摩擦方面所发挥的作用。迁移会打破传统的养老支持结构；在这一结构中，儿子居住在父母附近，并在父母年老时照料他们。我们构建了一个模型，说明嫁妆可以让儿子预先向父母转移资源、缓解收入分享约束，从而促进迁移。为检验这一假说，我们收集了两套新数据，用于衡量嫁妆在家庭成员之间的分配。研究首次记录到，嫁妆净转移给男方父母的现象较为常见，但远非普遍。与嫁妆被用于分享收入的解释一致，当儿子迁移时，这类转移更为常见；当儿子从事收入较高的职业时尤其如此。在全国代表性数据中，历史上嫁妆传统较强的地区迁移率更高。最后，利用一项大规模公路建设计划，我们发现，当迁移成本下降时，来自历史嫁妆传统较强地区的男性迁移得更多。研究结果为嫁妆为何在其负面后果已有充分记录的情况下仍然延续提供了一些线索。

records.title_en: Enlightenment Ideals and Belief in Progress in the Run-up to the Industrial Revolution: A Textual Analysis
records.title_cn: 工业革命前夕的启蒙理想和进步信念：文本分析
records.abstract_en: We trace the evolution of the language of science, religion, and political economy in the centuries leading to the British Industrial Revolution. Using textual analysis of 264,443 works printed in England between 1500 and 1900, we test whether British culture manifested a belief in progress associated with science and industry. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, there was a separation in the languages of science and religion beginning in the mid-eighteenth century. Second, volumes using language at the nexus of science and political economy became more progress-oriented during the Enlightenment. Third, volumes using industrial language—especially those at the science-political economy nexus—were more progress-oriented beginning in the eighteenth century.
records.abstract_cn: 我们追溯了英国工业革命之前的几个世纪里科学、宗教和政治经济学语言的演变。通过对 264,443 和 1500 期间英国印刷的 1900 作品进行文本分析，我们测试了英国文化是否表现出对与科学和工业相关的进步的信念。我们的分析得出了三主要发现。 第一，从十八世纪中叶开始，科学语言和宗教语言出现了分离。 第二，在启蒙运动期间，使用科学和政治经济学联系语言的书籍变得更加以进步为导向。 第三，使用工业语言的书籍——尤其是那些涉及科学与政治经济关系的书籍——在十八世纪开始更加注重进步。

records.title_en: Bargaining and Inequality in the Labor Market
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场的讨价还价和不平等
records.abstract_en: We use novel surveys of firms and workers, linked to administrative employer-employee data, to study the prevalence and importance of individual bargaining in wage determination. We show that simple survey questions accurately elicit firms’ bargaining strategies. Using the elicited strategies for 772 German firms, we document that the majority of firms are willing to engage in individual wage bargaining. Labor market factors predict firms’ strategies better than firm characteristics. Survey responses from nearly 10,000 full-time workers indicate that most workers provide their salary expectations before they receive a job offer. Most outside offers are rejected, with the worker remaining at the incumbent firm. There is substantial heterogeneity in workers’ bargaining behavior, which translates into within-firm wage inequality. Firms that set pay via individual bargaining have a 3 percentage point higher gender wage gap.
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用对企业和工人的新颖调查，与行政雇主-雇员数据相联系，来研究个人谈判在工资决定中的普遍性和重要性。我们表明，简单的调查问题可以准确地引出企业的讨价还价策略。使用772德国公司的引出策略，我们发现大多数公司愿意参与个人工资谈判。劳动力市场因素比企业特征更能预测企业战略。近 10,000 名全职工人的调查回复表明，大多数工人在收到工作机会之前都会提供他们的薪资期望。大多数外部报价都被拒绝，员工留在了现任公司。工人的讨价还价行为存在很大的异质性，这会转化为公司内部的工资不平等。通过个人谈判设定薪酬的公司的性别工资差距要高 3 个百分点。

records.title_en: Who’s Afraid of the Minimum Wage? Measuring the Impacts on Independent Businesses Using Matched U.S. Tax Returns
records.title_cn: 谁害怕最低工资？使用匹配的美国纳税申报表衡量对独立企业的影响
records.abstract_en: A common concern surrounding minimum wage policies is their impact on independent businesses, which are often feared to be less able to bear or pass on cost increases. We examine how these typically small and medium-size firms accommodate minimum wage increases along product and labor market margins using a matched owner-firm-worker panel data set drawn from the universe of U.S. tax records over a 10-year period, and using state minimum wage changes as identifying variation. We find that on average, firms in highly exposed industries do not substantially reduce employment—they do not lay off workers but moderately reduce part-time hiring. Instead, these firms are able to fully finance the new labor costs with new revenues, leaving average owner profits unchanged. Higher wage floors, however, forestall entry, particularly for less productive firms, reducing the number of independent firms operating in these industries by roughly 2%. Yet these industries do not shrink; instead, incumbent responses and strong positive selection among entrants reshape industries that rely heavily on low-wage workers, yielding fewer but more productive firms after the cost shock. We also take a worker-level perspective to examine how potentially vulnerable individuals are affected by minimum wage increases. Using panels of low-earning and young workers, we find that their average earnings rise substantially with the minimum wage, while they are no less likely to be employed. Worker transitions indicate that minimum wage increases boost retention and that worker reallocation from independent firms toward corporations buffers disemployment impacts from reduced hiring at independent firms.
records.abstract_cn: 围绕最低工资政策的一个普遍担忧是其对独立企业的影响，人们常常担心独立企业承受或转嫁成本上涨的能力较差。我们使用从10年期间美国税务记录中提取的匹配的所有者-公司-工人面板数据集，并使用州最低工资变化作为识别变化，研究了这些典型的中小型企业如何适应产品和劳动力市场利润的最低工资增长。我们发现，平均而言，高风险行业的企业不会大幅减少就业——它们不会裁员，但会适度减少兼职招聘。相反，这些公司能够用新的收入来充分支付新的劳动力成本，从而保持平均所有者利润不变。然而，较高的工资下限会阻止进入，特别是对于生产率较低的企业而言，从而使这些行业中运营的独立企业数量减少大约2%。然而，这些行业并没有萎缩，而是不断萎缩。相反，现有的应对措施和进入者之间强有力的积极选择重塑了严重依赖低工资工人的行业，在成本冲击后产生了更少但生产率更高的企业。我们还从工人的角度来研究潜在的弱势群体如何受到最低工资上涨的影响。通过对低收入工人和年轻工人的调查，我们发现他们的平均收入随着最低工资的提高而大幅上升，而他们的就业可能性并没有降低。工人的转变表明，最低工资的提高可以提高保留率，而工人从独立公司向企业的重新分配可以缓冲独立公司招聘减少带来的失业影响。

records.title_en: Marginal Returns to Public Universities
records.title_cn: 公立大学的边际回报
records.abstract_en: This article studies the returns to enrolling in U.S. public universities by comparing the long-term outcomes of barely admitted versus barely rejected applicants. I use administrative admission records spanning all 35 public universities in Texas, which collectively enroll 10% of all American public university students, to systematically identify and employ decentralized cutoffs in SAT/ACT scores that generate discontinuities in admission and enrollment. The typical marginally admitted student gains an additional year of education in the four-year sector, becomes 12 percentage points more likely to ever earn a bachelor’s degree, and eventually earns 8% more than their marginally rejected but otherwise identical counterpart. Marginally admitted students pay no additional tuition costs thanks to offsetting grant aid; cost-benefit calculations show internal rates of return of 26% for the marginal students themselves, 16% for society (which must pay for the additional education), and 7% for the government budget. Earnings gains are similar across admitting institutions of varying selectivity, but smaller for students from low-income families, who spend more time enrolled but complete fewer degrees and major in less lucrative fields. Finally, I develop a method to separately identify effects for students on the extensive margin of attending any university versus those on the margin of attending a more selective one, revealing larger effects on the extensive margin.
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过比较勉强录取和勉强拒绝的申请者的长期结果，研究美国公立大学的入学回报。我使用德克萨斯州所有 35 公立大学的行政录取记录（这些大学总共招收了所有美国公立大学学生的 10%），系统地识别和采用 SAT/ACT 分数中分散的截止点，这些截止点会导致入学和入学的不连续性。典型的被勉强录取的学生在四年级中获得额外一年的教育，获得学士学位的可能性提高12个百分点，并且最终比被勉强录取但其他方面相同的同行获得更多8%的收入。由于抵消助学金，勉强录取的学生无需支付额外的学费；成本效益计算显示，边缘学生本身的内部回报率为26%，社会（必须支付额外教育费用）的内部回报率为16%，政府预算的内部回报率为7%。不同选择性的录取院校的收入增长相似，但对于来自低收入家庭的学生来说，收入增长较小，他们花更多的时间入学，但完成的学位较少，并且主修利润较低的领域。最后，我开发了一种方法来分别确定学生对就读任何大学的广泛边缘的影响与那些对就读更有选择性的大学的边缘的影响，揭示了对广泛边缘的更大影响。

records.title_en: Republican Support and Economic Hardship: The Enduring Effects of the Opioid Epidemic
records.title_cn: 共和党的支持和经济困难：阿片类药物流行的持久影响
records.abstract_en: In this article, we establish a causal connection between two of the most salient social developments in the United States over the past decades: the opioid epidemic and the political realignment between the Republican and Democratic parties. Drawing on unsealed records from litigation against Purdue Pharma, we uncover rich geographic variation in the marketing of prescription opioids that serves as a quasi-exogenous source of exposure to the epidemic. We use this variation to document significant increases in drug-related mortality and greater reliance on public transfer programs. This induced economic hardship led to substantial changes in the political landscape of the communities most affected by the opioid epidemic. We estimate that from the mid-2000s to 2022, exposure to the opioid epidemic continuously increased the Republican vote share in House, presidential, and gubernatorial elections. By the 2022 House elections, a one-standard-deviation increase in our measure of exposure led to a 4.5 percentage point increase in the Republican vote share. From 2012 until 2022, this increase in the House vote share translated into Republicans winning additional seats.
records.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们在过去几十年来美国最显着的社会发展二之间建立了因果关系：阿片类药物的流行与共和党和民主党之间的政治重组。根据针对普渡制药公司诉讼的未密封记录，我们发现处方阿片类药物营销中存在丰富的地理差异，这是该流行病的准外源性暴露来源。我们利用这种变化来记录与毒品相关的死亡率的显着增加以及对公共转移计划的更大依赖。这种引发的经济困难导致受阿片类药物流行影响最严重的社区的政治格局发生了重大变化。我们估计，从2000中期到2022，阿片类药物流行的暴露持续增加了共和党在众议院、总统和州长选举中的选票份额。到 2022 众议院选举时，我们的风险敞口衡量标准的 一 标准差增加导致共和党选票份额增加 4.5 个百分点。从2012到2022，众议院投票份额的增加转化为共和党赢得了更多席位。

records.title_en: The Price of Housing in the United States, 1890–2006
records.title_cn: 美国的住房价格，1890-2006
records.abstract_en: We construct the first annual market rent and home sales price series for American cities over the twentieth century using 2.7 million newspaper real estate listings. Our findings revise several stylized facts about U.S. housing markets. Real market rents did not fall during the postwar period in most cities and rose nationally by 60% from 1890 to 2006. We also document higher sales price growth between 1953 and 1987 relative to previous series. Real prices reached almost four times their 1890 level by 2006. Prices grew most in metros with high demand and low levels of construction. We find that the rent-to-price ratio fell from about 8% in the early twentieth century to 3% by 2006, consistent with declines in the cost of owning housing relative to renting. For the typical year in our period, the annual return to owning housing was 9%, driven mostly by rental returns of 7.7%, with capital gains contributing only 1.3%. While capital gains were close to zero from 1890 to 1940, they grew to nearly a third of total returns from 1970 to 2006.
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用 2.7 百万 报纸房地产列表构建了二十世纪美国城市的 第一 年度市场租金和房屋销售价格系列。我们的研究结果修正了有关美国房地产市场的几个典型事实。战后时期，大多数城市的实际市场租金并未下降，并且从60%到1890在全国范围内上涨了2006。我们还记录了 1953 和 1987 之间相对于之前系列的更高的销售价格增长。到1890实际价格几乎达到2006水平的四倍。需求高、建设水平低的地铁价格涨幅最大。我们发现，租金价格比从二十世纪初的约8%下降到3%的2006，这与拥有住房相对于租赁成本的下降一致。在我们这个时期的典型年份中，拥有住房的年回报率为 9%，主要由 7.7% 的租金回报驱动，资本收益仅贡献 1.3%。虽然从1890到1940资本收益接近零，但从1970到2006它们增长到接近总回报的第三。

records.title_en: Dollar Dominance and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
records.title_cn: 美元主导地位与货币政策的传导
records.abstract_en: Has the dominance of the dollar in global trade rendered monetary policy ineffective? An emerging view contends that if a country invoices its exports in dollars, exchange rates cannot stabilize economic activity, as the classical expenditure-switching channel is muted. This view rests on the premise that export prices are sticky in dollars, breaking the link between export demand and depreciations. But this assumption is not borne out by the data: goods priced in dollars tend to have more flexible prices, along with higher elasticities of substitution. We propose a model with more realistic assumptions and show that even with dollar pricing, depreciating the currency by loosening monetary policy can still boost exports and activity materially. The limit to any expansion is not demand, but supply capacity. We also show that low exchange rate pass-through to dollar prices is not informative about price stickiness. The price response to exchange rates is small when demand elasticities are high, even with flexible prices: low pass-through is an equilibrium result, not evidence of a nominal friction.
records.abstract_cn: 美元在全球贸易中的主导地位是否导致货币政策失效？一种新的观点认为，如果一个国家以美元为其出口发票，汇率就无法稳定经济活动，因为传统的支出转换渠道被抑制。这种观点的前提是出口价格以美元计价具有粘性，从而打破了出口需求与贬值之间的联系。但数据并没有证实这一假设：以美元计价的商品往往具有更灵活的价格，以及更高的替代弹性。我们提出了一个具有更现实假设的模型，并表明即使以美元定价，通过放松货币政策使货币贬值仍然可以实质性地促进出口和活动。任何扩张的限制不是需求，而是供给能力。我们还表明，低汇率对美元价格的传导并不能提供有关价格粘性的信息。当需求弹性较高时，即使价格灵活，价格对汇率的反应也较小：低传导率是均衡结果，而不是名义摩擦的证据。

records.title_en: Permanent Capital Losses after Banking Crises
records.title_cn: 银行业危机后的永久性资本损失
records.abstract_en: We study the mechanisms driving bank losses across historical banking crises in 46 economies and the effectiveness of policy interventions in restoring bank capitalization. We find that bank stocks experience large, permanent declines at the onset of crises. These losses predict commensurate long-term declines in banks’ earnings and dividends, rather than elevated future equity returns. Bank losses are primarily driven by write-downs of nonperforming assets, not asset sales during panics. Forceful liquidity-based interventions during crises predict only small, temporary increases in bank market value. Overall, these results suggest that bank losses during crises are not primarily due to temporary price dislocations. Early liquidity interventions can avert banking crises, but only under specific conditions. Once large bank equity declines have occurred, policy responses have historically failed to prevent persistent undercapitalization in the banking sector.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了46经济体历史银行危机中导致银行损失的机制以及政策干预在恢复银行资本方面的有效性。我们发现，银行股在危机爆发时会经历大幅、永久性的下跌。这些损失预示着银行盈利和股息的长期相应下降，而不是未来股票回报率的上升。银行损失主要是由不良资产减记造成的，而不是恐慌期间的资产出售。危机期间基于流动性的强有力的干预措施只会导致银行市值出现小幅、暂时的增长。总体而言，这些结果表明，危机期间银行的损失并非主要是由于暂时的价格混乱造成的。早期流动性干预可以避免银行业危机，但只能在特定条件下进行。从历史上看，一旦银行股本大幅下跌，政策应对措施就无法阻止银行业持续资本不足。

records.title_en: Political Foundations of Racial Violence in the Post-Reconstruction South
records.title_cn: 重建后南方种族暴力的政治基础
records.abstract_en: Election results act as powerful signals, shaping social behavior in ways that can be dramatic and even violent. This article shows how racial violence in the post-Reconstruction U.S. South was tied to the local performance of the anti-Black Democratic Party in presidential elections. Using a regression discontinuity design based on close presidential vote shares, we find that Southern counties where Democrats lost the popular vote between 1880 and 1900 were nearly twice as likely to experience Black lynchings in the following four years. Despite no corresponding changes in local office holding, these defeats were salient among local elites. We show that Southern newspapers, closely aligned with the Democratic Party, amplified narratives of Black criminality in the aftermath of Democratic losses. Such accusations were, in turn, frequently invoked by lynch mobs. These findings point to the strategic use of racial violence by Democratic elites, foreshadowing the institutionalized vote suppression of Jim Crow.
records.abstract_cn: 选举结果是强有力的信号，以戏剧性甚至暴力的方式塑造社会行为。本文展示了重建后的美国南部的种族暴力如何与反黑人民主党在总统选举中的当地表现联系在一起。使用基于接近的总统选票份额的回归不连续性设计，我们发现民主党在1880和1900之间失去普选的南部县在接下来的四年里经历黑人私刑的可能性几乎是其两倍。尽管地方公职没有发生相应的变化，但这些失败在地方精英中尤为突出。我们发现，与民主党关系密切的南方报纸在民主党失败后夸大了黑人犯罪行为的叙述。反过来，此类指控也经常被私刑暴徒援引。这些发现表明民主党精英战略性地使用种族暴力，预示着制度化的吉姆·克劳投票压制。

records.title_en: Vanguard: Black Veterans and Civil Rights After World War I
records.title_cn: 先锋：第一次世界大战后的黑人退伍军人和民权
records.abstract_en: Nearly 400,000 Black men were drafted into the National Army during World War I, where they toiled primarily as menial laborers in segregated units. Leveraging novel variation from the World War I draft lottery and millions of digitized military and NAACP records, we document the pioneering role these men played in the early civil rights movement. Relative to observably similar individuals from the same draft board, Black men randomly inducted into the Army were significantly more likely to join the nascent NAACP and become prominent community leaders in the New Negro era. We find little evidence that these effects are explained by migration or improved socioeconomic status. Rather, corroborating historical accounts about the catalyzing influence of institutional racism in the military, we show that increased civic activism was driven by soldiers who experienced the most discriminatory treatment while serving their country.
records.abstract_cn: 第一次世界大战期间，近400,000黑人被征召入伍，他们主要在隔离部队中充当卑微的劳工。利用第一次世界大战抽签的新颖变化以及数以百万计的数字化军事和全国有色人种协进会记录，我们记录了这些人在早期民权运动中发挥的先锋作用。与来自同一征兵委员会的明显相似的个人相比，随机入伍的黑人更有可能加入新生的全国有色人种协进会并成为新黑人时代杰出的社区领袖。我们发现几乎没有证据表明这些影响可以用移民或社会经济地位的改善来解释。相反，我们证实了关于军队中制度性种族主义催化影响的历史记载，表明公民活动的增加是由在为国家服务时经历最歧视性待遇的士兵推动的。

records.title_en: Ideas Have Consequences: The Impact of Law and Economics on American Justice
records.title_cn: 想法有后果：法律和经济学对美国司法的影响
records.abstract_en: This article empirically studies the effects of the early law and economics movement on the U.S. judiciary. We focus on the Manne Economics Institute for Federal Judges, an intensive economics course that trained almost half of federal judges between 1976 and 1999. Using the universe of published opinions in U.S. Circuit Courts and 1 million District Court criminal sentencing decisions, we estimate the within-judge effect of Manne program attendance. Selection into attendance was limited, as the program was popular among judges of all backgrounds, frequently oversubscribed, and admitted participants on a first-come, first-served basis. We find that after attending economics training, participating judges use more economics language in their opinions, rule against regulatory agencies more often, and impose more severe criminal sentences. We argue that economics, as a rigorous social science, was especially effective in persuading judges.
records.abstract_cn: 本文实证研究了早期法律和经济运动对美国司法部门的影响。我们重点关注联邦法官曼恩经济学院，这是一门强化经济学课程，在1976和1999之间培训了几乎一半的联邦法官。利用美国巡回法院发表的大量意见和 1 百万 地方法院的刑事量刑决定，我们估计了曼恩计划出勤的法官内部影响。参加人数的选择是有限的，因为该计划在各种背景的评委中都很受欢迎，经常超额认购，并且以第一来，第一服务的方式录取参与者。我们发现，参加经济学培训后，参与的法官在意见中使用更多的经济学语言，更频繁地对监管机构作出裁决，并判处更严厉的刑事判决。我们认为，经济学作为一门严谨的社会科学，在说服法官方面尤其有效。

records.title_en: The Short-Run Policy Constraints of Long-Run Expectations
records.title_cn: 长期预期的短期政策约束
records.abstract_en: This paper provides theory and evidence that distorted long-term interest rate expectations limit the effectiveness of monetary policy. Beliefs that depart from rational expectations break the tight link between policy rates and long-term interest rates, even when determined by the expectations hypothesis of the yield curve. Because long-term expectations are excessively sensitive to short-term interest rates, optimal policy is less aggressive relative to rational expectations. More aggressive policy leads to suboptimal volatility in long-term interest rates and aggregate demand through standard intertemporal substitution effects. These effects are quantitatively important in the United States over the postwar period.
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了扭曲的长期利率预期限制货币政策有效性的理论和证据。背离理性预期的信念打破了政策利率与长期利率之间的紧密联系，即使是由收益率曲线的预期假设决定的。由于长期预期对短期利率过于敏感，最优政策相对于理性预期来说不太激进。更激进的政策会通过标准的跨期替代效应导致长期利率和总需求的次优波动。这些影响在战后时期的美国具有重要的数量意义。

records.title_en: Screening with Persuasion
records.title_cn: 说服筛选
records.abstract_en: We analyze a nonlinear pricing model where the seller controls both product pricing (screening) and buyer information about their own values (persuasion). We prove that the optimal mechanism always consists of finitely many signals and items, even with a continuum of buyer values. The seller optimally pools buyer values and reduces product variety to minimize informational rents. We show that value pooling is optimal even for finite value distributions if their entropy exceeds a critical threshold. We also provide sufficient conditions under which the optimal menu restricts offering to a single item.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个非线性定价模型，其中卖方控制产品定价（筛选）和买方有关其自身价值观的信息（说服）。我们证明，即使买家价值是连续的，最优机制也始终由有限多个信号和项目组成。卖方以最佳方式汇集买方价值并减少产品种类，以最大限度地减少信息租金。我们表明，即使对于有限值分布，如果其熵超过临界阈值，价值池也是最佳的。我们还提供了充分的条件，在该条件下最佳菜单限制提供单一项目。

records.title_en: Trade with Nominal Rigidities: Understanding the Unemployment and Welfare Effects of the China Shock
records.title_cn: 名义刚性贸易：了解中国冲击对失业和福利的影响
records.abstract_en: We present a dynamic quantitative trade and migration model that incorporates downward nominal wage rigidities and show how this framework can generate changes in unemployment and labor participation that match those uncovered by the empirical literature studying the China shock. We find that the China shock leads to average welfare increases in most US states, including many that experience unemployment during the transition. However, nominal rigidities reduce the overall US gains by around two-thirds. In addition, there are 18 states that experience welfare losses in the presence of downward nominal wage rigidity that would have experienced gains without it.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个动态的定量贸易和移民模型，其中纳入了名义工资刚性的下降，并展示了该框架如何产生与研究中国冲击的实证文献所揭示的失业率和劳动力参与度相匹配的变化。我们发现，中国冲击导致美国大多数州的平均福利增加，其中包括许多在转型期间经历失业的州。然而，名义刚性使美国整体收益减少了约二三分之一。此外，还有18州在名义工资刚性下降的情况下经历了福利损失，而如果没有名义工资刚性下降，这些州本来会获得福利。

records.title_en: Gender, Confidence, and the Mismeasure of Intelligence, Competitiveness, and Literacy
records.title_cn: 性别、信心以及对智力、竞争力和读写能力的错误衡量
records.abstract_en: The measurement of intelligence should identify and measure an individual’s subjective confidence that a response to a test question is correct. Existing measures do not do that, nor do they use extrinsic financial incentive for truthful responses. We rectify both issues and show that each matters for the measurement of intelligence, particularly for women. Our results on gender and confidence in the face of risk have wider applications in terms of the measurement of “competitiveness” and financial literacy. Contrary to received literature, women are more intelligent than men, compete when they should in risky settings, and are more literate.
records.abstract_cn: 智力的测量应该识别和测量个体对测试问题的回答是否正确的主观信心。现有措施并没有做到这一点，也没有利用外在的经济激励来做出真实的反应。我们纠正了这两个问题，并表明每个问题对于智力测量都很重要，特别是对于女性而言。我们关于性别和面对风险的信心的结果在衡量“竞争力”和金融知识方面具有更广泛的应用。与公认的文献相反，女性比男性更聪明，在危险的环境中应该参加竞争，并且更有文化。

records.title_en: Laws and Norms
records.title_cn: 法律和规范
records.abstract_en: We analyze how private decisions and optimal public policies are shaped by personal and societal preferences, material incentives, and social norms. We show how incentives interact with honor and stigma, deriving optimal taxation. We then analyze the expressive role of law as embodying society’s values and when it calls for a weakening or a strengthening of incentives. The law should be softened when it signals agents’ willingness to contribute to the public good and toughened when it signals social externalities. We also shed light on norms-based interventions, societies’ resistance to economists’ messages, and the avoidance of cruel and unusual punishments.
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析个人和社会偏好、物质激励和社会规范如何影响私人决策和最佳公共政策。我们展示了激励措施如何与荣誉和耻辱相互作用，从而产生最佳税收。然后，我们分析法律在体现社会价值观方面的表达作用，以及何时需要削弱或加强激励措施。当法律表明代理人愿意为公共利益做出贡献时，法律应该软化；当法律表明社会外部性时，法律应该加强。我们还阐明了基于规范的干预措施、社会对经济学家信息的抵制，以及避免残酷和不寻常的惩罚。

records.title_en: When Is the Use of Gaussian-Inverse Wishart-Haar Priors Appropriate?
records.title_cn: 何时适合使用高斯逆 Wishart-Haar 先验？
records.abstract_en: We provide evidence that the quantitative importance of the Haar prior for posterior impulse response inference has been overstated. How sensitive posterior inference is to the Haar prior depends on the width of the identified set. This width depends not only on how much the identified set is narrowed by the identifying restrictions but also on the data through the reduced-form model parameters. Hence, the role of the Haar prior can be assessed only on a case-by-case basis. We show by example that when the identification is sufficiently tight, posterior inference based on a Gaussian-inverse Wishart-Haar prior is justified.
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供的证据表明，哈尔先验对于后验脉冲响应推断的定量重要性被夸大了。后验推理对哈尔先验的敏感程度取决于识别集的宽度。该宽度不仅取决于识别限制将识别集缩小的程度，还取决于通过简化形式模型参数得到的数据。因此，哈尔先验的作用只能根据具体情况进行评估。我们通过例子证明，当识别足够严格时，基于高斯逆 Wishart-Haar 先验的后验推理是合理的。

records.title_en: A Case for Pay-as-Bid Auctions
records.title_cn: 竞价付费拍卖案例
records.abstract_en: Pay-as-bid (or discriminatory or multiple-price) auctions are used to sell homogenous goods, such as treasury securities and commodities. We prove the uniqueness of their pure-strategy Bayesian Nash equilibrium and establish a tractable representation of equilibrium bids for symmetrically informed bidders. Analyzing design, we show that supply transparency and full disclosure are revenue maximizing in pay-as-bid, though not necessarily in uniform-price (or single-price), auctions—the main alternative auction format. Pay as bid raises weakly more revenue than uniform price and may lead to higher welfare. Our results provide an explanation for the revenue equivalence observed in empirical studies of treasury auctions.
records.abstract_cn: 按出价付费（或歧视性或多价）拍卖用于销售同质商品，例如国债和商品。我们证明了他们的纯策略贝叶斯纳什均衡的独特性，并为对称知情的投标人建立了均衡投标的易于处理的表示。通过分析设计，我们表明供应透明度和充分披露是按投标付费的收入最大化，尽管不一定在统一价格（或单一价格）拍卖（主要的替代拍卖形式）中。按投标付费比统一价格增加的收入微弱，并且可能带来更高的福利。我们的结果为国债拍卖实证研究中观察到的收入等值提供了解释。

records.title_en: "Potential" and the Gender Promotion Gap
records.title_cn: “潜力”与性别晋升差距
records.abstract_en: We show that subjective assessments of employee "potential" contribute to gender gaps in promotion and pay. Using data on 29,809 management-track employees from a large retail chain, we find that women receive substantially lower potential ratings despite receiving higher performance ratings. Differences in potential ratings account for approximately half of the gender promotion gap. Women's lower potential ratings do not reflect accurate forecasts of future performance: Women subsequently outperform male colleagues, both on average and on the margin of promotion. We highlight two mechanisms driving the gender potential gap: strategic retention and stereotyping.
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，对员工“潜力”的主观评估会导致晋升和薪酬方面的性别差距。使用大型零售连锁店 29,809 管理层员工的数据，我们发现，尽管女性的绩效评级较高，但其潜在评级却明显较低。潜在评级的差异约占性别晋升差距的一半。女性较低的潜在评级并不能反映对未来绩效的准确预测：女性随后在平均表现和晋升幅度上都优于男性同事。我们强调二驱动性别潜在差距的机制：战略保留和刻板印象。

records.title_en: Evaluating the Impact of Urban Transit Infrastructure: Evidence from Bogotá's TransMilenio
records.title_cn: 评估城市交通基础设施的影响：来自波哥大 TransMilenio 的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the effects of improving public transit infrastructure on city structure and welfare. It develops a quantitative urban model with multiple worker groups and transit modes, and derives a special case yielding sufficient statistics for aggregate welfare in a broad class of models. The paper estimates reduced-form elasticities to implement the approach using data spanning construction of the world's largest Bus Rapid Transit system in Bogotá, Colombia. This class of models explains observed adjustments in economic activity. Standard value-of-time calculations capture only 52 percent of welfare gains. Accounting for reallocation and general equilibrium effects, distributional impacts are modest.
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了改善公共交通基础设施对城市结构和福利的影响。它开发了一个具有多个工人群体和交通方式的定量城市模型，并得出了一个特例，为广泛的模型中的总福利提供了足够的统计数据。该论文利用哥伦比亚波哥大世界上最大的快速公交系统建设的数据，估计了实施该方法的简化形式弹性。此类模型解释了观察到的经济活动调整。标准时间价值计算仅捕获52%的福利收益。考虑到重新分配和一般均衡效应，分配影响不大。

records.title_en: Financial Frictions: Micro versus Macro Volatility
records.title_cn: 金融摩擦：微观波动与宏观波动
records.abstract_en: We argue that consumer credit spreads matter for household choices and that time-varying spreads have important distributional consequences. Studying Danish household data, we show that consumer credit spreads have heterogeneous impact on asset dynamics and consumption choices across the wealth distribution and that time-varying spreads induce a countercyclical marginal propensity to consume. We study a HANK model where banks provide consumer credit and corporate loans. Through countercyclical credit spreads, frictional finance amplifies aggregate shocks and induces consumption inequality. Economies with less leveraged banks experience reduced aggregate volatility but may face higher volatility and lower welfare at the household level.
records.abstract_cn: 我们认为，消费者信贷利差对家庭选择很重要，并且随时间变化的利差具有重要的分配后果。通过研究丹麦家庭数据，我们发现消费信贷利差对财富分配中的资产动态和消费选择具有异质性影响，并且随时间变化的利差会引发反周期边际消费倾向。我们研究了HANK模型，其中银行提供消费信贷和企业贷款。通过反周期信用利差，摩擦金融放大了总体冲击并导致消费不平等。银行杠杆率较低的经济体总体波动性降低，但家庭层面可能面临更高的波动性和更低的福利。

records.title_en: Raising the Stakes: Physician Facility Investments and Provider Agency
records.title_cn: 提高赌注：医师设施投资和提供商代理
records.abstract_en: Principal-agent problems often extend beyond what can be directly addressed through conventional incentive arrangements. We examine a context where physicians are likely under-incentivized to minimize total medical costs until their private financial interests align with those of patients. Leveraging novel data on physician ownership of ambulatory surgery centers—that is, same-day facilities—we show that these equity holdings cause a substitution away from higher cost, rival settings that lowers Medicare spending by 10–40 percent per physician. We find no clear evidence of perverse behavior following these investments. Instead, our findings demonstrate how entrepreneurial activity can indirectly limit principal-agent problems and improve efficiency.
records.abstract_cn: 委托代理问题往往超出了传统激励安排所能直接解决的范围。我们研究了这样一种情况：在医生的私人经济利益与患者的经济利益一致之前，他们可能没有动力将总医疗成本降至最低。利用关于医生拥有门诊手术中心（即当日手术设施）的新数据，我们表明，这些股权持有会导致成本较高、竞争环境的替代，从而使每位医生的医疗保险支出降低10-40%。我们没有发现这些投资后出现不当行为的明确证据。相反，我们的研究结果表明创业活动如何能够间接限制委托代理问题并提高效率。

records.title_en: Competition under Incomplete Contracts and the Design of Procurement Policies
records.title_cn: 不完全合同下的竞争与采购政策设计
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of intensifying competition for contracts in the context of US Defense procurement. Leveraging a discontinuous regulation that mandates agencies to publicize certain contract opportunities, we document that expanding the set of bidders reduces award prices but deteriorates post-award performance in terms of cost overruns and delays. We develop and estimate an auction model with endogenous entry and stochastic execution performance, in which the buyer endogenously chooses the intensity of competition. Model estimates indicate substantial heterogeneity in performance across contractors and show that simple adjustments to the current regulation could provide significant savings in procurement spending.
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了美国国防采购背景下合同竞争加剧的影响。利用强制各机构公布某些合同机会的不连续监管，我们发现，扩大投标人范围会降低中标价格，但会恶化中标后在成本超支和延误方面的表现。我们开发并估计了具有内生进入和随机执行绩效的拍卖模型，其中买方内生选择竞争强度。模型估计表明，承包商之间的绩效存在显着差异，并表明对现行法规的简单调整可以显着节省采购支出。

records.title_en: Take the Goods and Run: Contracting Frictions and Market Power in Supply Chains
records.title_cn: 拿走货物就跑：供应链中的收缩摩擦和市场力量
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the efficiency of self-enforced relational agreements, a common solution to contracting frictions, when sellers have market power and contracts cannot be externally enforced. To this end, I develop a dynamic contracting model with limited enforcement in which buyers can default on their trade credit debt and estimate it using a novel dataset from the Ecuadorian manufacturing supply chain.
